description: Scalar subquery projecting a windowed aggregate is nullable: a window function produces one row per input row, so zero matching rows yields zero result rows and the subquery evaluates to SQL NULL

columns.name: running_total
columns.note: SUM(total) OVER () is non-nullable within a row, but the subquery returns no row at all when the user has no orders, so the projected value is nullable

name: scalar_subquery_windowed_aggregate_nullable
query_sql:
-- @name GetRunningTotal
-- @returns :many
SELECT id, (SELECT SUM(total) OVER () FROM orders WHERE orders.user_id = users.id LIMIT 1) AS running_total FROM users
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, email TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active', bio TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
CREATE TABLE orders (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, user_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id), total INTEGER NOT NULL, notes TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now())
